notes.title: Patch 0.3
notes.content:
---------------------RELEASE Patch ----------------

-2 New memory fragments involving Andrew of the Original Shore

-New Device  added in the lighthouse (Voice recorder with the speech of Andrew)

-The strange coins around the lighthouse can be "collected", there are 7 to be found.
-"Coins counter" on the menu island

-More fresh spawns added on the island, the total is now 15.
All 15 are needed to unlock the achievement.
-"Fresh spawn counter" on the menu island

-5 New achievements have been added 
  -Finding all the Coins
  -Finding all Fragments
  -Finding all letters from the bottles 
  -Completing the journal (9 letters + 9 notes)
  -Hidden Achievement

- Tutorial text display modification.
- Menu text display modification.
The method text is displayed on the menu and tutorial panels has been changed In order to support foreign characters. This change was necessary to make for adding new languages post release, it should barely be noticeable.(New languages will be added after release)

-Credits tab added in the Main Menu 
-Small bug fixed with some journal pages texture 
-Fixed another "spawn under the map" bug
-Fixed a bug with the camera rotation spawning with "Snap" when the "smooth" option was saved
-Fixed some problems with the achievement "It's getting closer", it sometimes wouldn't trigger properly

notes.title: PATCH 0.2
notes.content:
PATCH 0.2

-New fragment at the Lighthouse
-New fragment in a cave

-Interactive Seagulls, those annoying seagulls now can be grabbed now ! 

-You can now punch the creatures, although, it's only recommended to punch the Voidsouls, they can't fight back!
-Voidsouls now wonder around the void, they no longer stand in one place.

-Many more interactive objects on the island!
Bones, pieces of woods, crates, candles, etc.
Pretty much, most of the smaller objects can be now grabbed by the player.

-The cat now reacts to the player petting it.

-Spear System Change
You no longer carry a spear on your back at all times, instead, multiple spears will be close to any event that requires combat or any fresh spawn.
To grab a spear you just have to press either the left or right "Grip button" and don't worry you don't have to hold down the button, to let go of the spear just press it again!
Only spears close to combat events can be used, if a spear doesn't react to the grip button input, It's just for decorative porpouses.
And lastly, there's a total of 3 spear variations, but they all do the same damage.

-Tutorial updated + videos added

-Journal collision improved
-Spear collision slightly adjusted, making it easier to hit enemies
-Music volume rebalance during smaller events, such as fragments, portal activations and servant event.
-Fixed a bug with the save locations once you killed a fresh spawn
-Fixed small bug with Cthulhu summoning altar save location
-Minor Menu input change bug fix.

notes.title: Patch 0.1 is now Available
notes.content:
[b]Content Additions [/b]
The fragment system 
3 available fragment memories.
Interact with the fragments to reveal past events!
A new cave is now available with fragmented memory.
*The fragment memories will be voice acted on the full release.
*More fragment memories will be added every week.

[b]Bottles and letters are now available for VR.[/b]
Bottles make their return but improved for VR.
To get to the message inside you must break open the bottle.
To break open a bottle grab and throw it against the rocks or just use your spear!

[b]Lighthouse additions[/b]
You are now able to interact with more items inside the lighthouse.
*More items are scheduled for future updates.

[b]Improvements[/b]
Height Setting in the Gameplay Tab is now adjustable.
Tutorial panels have more information.
Collision fixes on the island and the void.
[b]
Some of the bugs fixed[/b]
Fixed a bug where the Nyarlathotep event would give you another artifact after completing it already.
Fixed the bug where the water floor of the void level was causing problems to certain headsets.
80% of the invisible walls around the island have been removed, giving players more freedom to explore the island.
Fixed a bug where the basement would cause frame drops to certain headsets
